Same standard and method as batch 1 (see correction-api00c-644-hostap-b1-task1541): each task-644-full-reaudit row re-derived at hostap dcee6043 under the bmdb 769 API00-C standard, per flagged parameter. A parameter counts as validated only by a genuine guard on the parameter itself, by every real call site passing an address-of, literal or array, or by being forwarded only to null-tolerant callees. assert() is no validation, and neither is a config-macro-only guard. An array member or &base->member counts as an array or address-of only where the base pointer is shown valid at the call site. A caller set that runs through an open entry point does not close. The flagged parameter is the one aurora-lint names at that key in realworld run 274; each flipped key names exactly one.
